title: Indicative salary range leaves negotiated minimum unresolved

units.rationale: The indicative range is below the minimum, but the source explicitly leaves above-range negotiated offers possible; the final offer is absent.
required_points: CHF 160,000 is above the indicative CHF 150,000 ceiling.
forbidden_inferences: Do not assert a CHF 160,000 offer is available or impossible.

units.rationale: Remote work within Switzerland exactly matches the location preference.
required_points: Fully remote work in Switzerland is stated.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer permission outside Switzerland.

units.rationale: At most two trips is within the candidate’s three-trip soft limit.
required_points: The role caps travel at two trips per year.

critical_errors.description: Misreads Indicative salary range leaves negotiated minimum unresolved: the salary preference or its cited role term.
Treating the indicative CHF 150,000 ceiling as a final cap falsely converts an unknown CHF 160,000 minimum to conflict.

notes: The quoted range and candidate minimum use the same currency, units and pay component; legal and tax claims are out of scope.
